trustPage.title: Security & Trust
trustPage.intro: Zakai is built around trust: we act on your behalf toward companies and handle sensitive financial data. This page explains, transparently, how we protect your data and how the fee model works.
security: Encryption in transit: all communication with the site is encrypted over HTTPS/TLS, with an HSTS policy that enforces a secure connection.
Encryption at rest: data is stored in a managed database with storage-layer encryption.
Secrets & keys: API keys and secrets are never in the code — they are injected only as secure environment variables.
Verification codes: the SMS ownership code is stored hashed only (never in the clear), with expiry and an attempt cap.
Rate limiting: login, signup and code-sending endpoints are rate-limited to prevent abuse.
Monitoring: system errors are logged and monitored so issues are detected and fixed quickly.
Dependency scanning: software dependencies are scanned automatically for known vulnerabilities.
trust: We charge an 18% fee only from documented actual savings (a documented difference between the original and new amount). No saving — no charge.
Every request is sent only after your explicit approval, and after account-ownership verification plus an authorization document with a code the company can check.
Every request discloses to the company that Zakai is a digital agent acting on your behalf — we never impersonate you.
No overblown promises: Zakai is an automated tool that drafts and sends requests, not an 'expert' with human experience.
trustPage.differentHeading: Why this isn't just another AI assistant
trustPage.differentIntro: Any AI assistant can draft a letter. That's not the difference. The difference is in things that need dedicated infrastructure, not just conversation — and they're here, not just in marketing copy.
different: Cryptographically verified authorization, not just a chat promise: every request goes out with a signed authorization (Ed25519) the receiving company can verify itself against a public key — you don't take our word for it, you check.
Deterministic fee and eligibility math, not an LLM: the amount charged is computed by tested code, not guessed by a language model that can make mistakes.
Learns from real outcomes, not just general training: every closed case (won or lost) feeds back into the engine that picks how to word the next request — a proprietary dataset that grows over time.
Fee only on documented success: if you didn't actually get money back, there's no charge — our incentive is aligned with your outcome, not with how many questions you asked.

flights.title: Flight cancelled or delayed? You're owed money.
flights.subtitle: Israel's Aviation Services Law obligates airlines to fixed compensation, an alternative ticket and assistance — low-cost carriers included. Three taps to know what you're owed.
flights.noticeQ: When were you notified of the cancellation?
flights.noticeShort: Less than 14 days before the flight
flights.resultTitle: What the law entitles you to
flights.refund: Ticket refund or an alternative flight — your choice
flights.assistance: Airport assistance: food and drink, communication, and lodging when needed
flights.notEntitled: In this case the law grants no automatic entitlement. If you suffered real damages, other grounds may exist — keep your receipts.

notes.noticeExempt: With 14+ days notice there is no automatic monetary compensation, but you are owed a refund or an alternative ticket.
notes.shortDelay: A delay under two hours grants no entitlement under the law.
notes.longDelayAsCancellation: A delay of more than 8 hours counts as a cancelled flight under the law.
notes.exceptions: Airlines have narrow statutory exemptions (e.g. extraordinary circumstances beyond their control). Compensation is not automatic in those cases.
notes.indexed: Statutory amounts (2023 base) are index-linked — the exact figure is set at claim time.
notes.eu3h: Under EU case law, a 3h+ arrival delay is compensated like a cancellation.
notes.euExceptions: Airlines are exempt in 'extraordinary circumstances' (extreme weather, certain strikes); ordinary technical faults usually are NOT exempt.

flights.disclaimer: Based on the Aviation Services Law (Compensation and Assistance for Flight Cancellation or Change of Conditions), 2012. Not legal advice. Coming soon: Zakai prepares the full demand for you — ready for you to send yourself.
flights.euDisclaimer: Based on Regulation (EC) 261/2004 — flights departing the EU, or arriving in the EU on an EU carrier. Not legal advice. Coming soon: Zakai prepares the full demand for you — ready for you to send yourself.

letter.privacy: Generated in your browser only — details are never sent or stored. Not legal advice.

rights.title: The Big Rights Check
rights.subtitle: 76 rights and benefits in one place — tax, national insurance, arnona, banking, army, family and housing. Answer 8 quick questions and get your list. No signup; computed in your browser.

q.dischargedSoldier: Discharged from the IDF in the last 5 years

rights.quantified: Of these, conservatively quantifiable: at least {amount} a year — plus many whose value depends on your case.
rights.disclaimer: General orientation only — not legal/tax advice; actual eligibility is decided by the competent authority. Amounts are conservative estimates; exact terms on official sites.

tax_refund.title: Income-tax refund
tax_refund.desc: Worked part of the year, switched jobs, or never coordinated tax? You may have overpaid.
tax_refund.how: Free check and filing at the Tax Authority portal, up to 6 years back.

work_grant.title: Work grant (negative income tax)
work_grant.desc: A yearly top-up for low-wage workers — paid straight to your account.
work_grant.how: Check eligibility on the Tax Authority site.

credit_children.title: Tax credit points for children
credit_children.desc: Parents get credit points that lower monthly tax.
credit_children.how: Make sure your employer's Form 101 lists all your children.

credit_degree.title: Credit point for graduates
credit_degree.desc: Finished a degree or vocational program? A credit point applies after graduation.
credit_degree.how: File Form 119 with your degree certificate.

credit_oleh.title: New-immigrant credit points
credit_oleh.desc: Olim get graduated credit points in their first years.
credit_oleh.how: Update your aliyah date on Form 101.

credit_discharged.title: Discharged-soldier credit points
credit_discharged.desc: Credit points for three years after discharge.
credit_discharged.how: Update your discharge date on Form 101 — it's not automatic.

credit_donations.title: Donation tax credit
credit_donations.desc: Donations to recognized charities above the threshold earn a 35% credit.
credit_donations.how: Keep Section-46 receipts and claim via employer or annual return.

credit_pension_deposit.title: Pension deposit tax benefit
credit_pension_deposit.desc: Independent pension deposits earn deductions and credits.
credit_pension_deposit.how: Deposit up to the benefit ceiling and claim in your return.

tax_disability_exemption.title: Tax exemption for qualifying disability
tax_disability_exemption.desc: A qualifying medical disability may exempt income from tax.
tax_disability_exemption.how: Medical committee via the Tax Authority; check retroactively.

child_allowance.title: Child allowance
child_allowance.desc: Paid automatically — verify all children are registered.
child_allowance.how: Check your National Insurance personal area.

maternity_grant.title: Birth grant & maternity pay
maternity_grant.desc: One-time grant plus paid leave for the parent.
maternity_grant.how: Grant is automatic; maternity pay needs a claim.

unemployment_benefit.title: Unemployment benefits
unemployment_benefit.desc: Laid off or finished a job? You may qualify.
unemployment_benefit.how: Register at the Employment Service immediately, then claim.

income_support.title: Income support
income_support.desc: A safety net when there's no sufficient income.
income_support.how: Claim at National Insurance with income documents.

old_age_pension.title: Old-age (senior) pension
old_age_pension.desc: Monthly pension from retirement age, with income supplement.
old_age_pension.how: Claim about six months before eligibility age.

miluim_pay.title: Reserve-duty pay & grants
miluim_pay.desc: Pay per service day plus grants for active reservists.
miluim_pay.how: Via employer/National Insurance; grants in the Miluim portal.

disability_allowance.title: General disability allowance
disability_allowance.desc: Monthly allowance when earning capacity is impaired.
disability_allowance.how: Claim + medical committee at National Insurance.

long_term_care_benefit.title: Long-term care benefit
long_term_care_benefit.desc: Funds home-care hours for elderly people who need help with daily activities — depends on a functional assessment and an income test.
long_term_care_benefit.how: Zakai prepares the request to National Insurance and the functional-dependency assessment.

arnona_income.title: Income-based arnona discount
arnona_income.desc: Up to 90% off by per-person income test.

arnona_oleh.title: New-immigrant arnona discount
arnona_oleh.desc: Up to 90% off the first 100m² for one year.
arnona_oleh.how: Apply at city hall with your immigrant certificate.

arnona_senior.title: Senior arnona discount
arnona_senior.desc: 30%+ off the first 100m², more with benefits.
arnona_senior.how: One-time application with your senior card.

arnona_disability.title: Disability arnona discount
arnona_disability.desc: Significant discounts by disability type and degree.

arnona_soldier.title: Soldier arnona exemption
arnona_soldier.desc: Conscripts get an exemption/deep discount until discharge.

arnona_large_family.title: Large-family arnona discount
arnona_large_family.desc: A sliding-scale discount by child count and household income — varies by municipality.
arnona_large_family.how: Zakai prepares the application and points to the form and documents your municipality requires.

water_disability.title: Extra discounted water quota
water_disability.desc: National Insurance beneficiaries get a larger low-rate quota.
water_disability.how: Verify it appears on your water bill.

arnona_area_correction.title: Fix an incorrect property size on arnona
arnona_area_correction.desc: If the registered area is larger than the real one, you can object within 90 days of the tax notice.
arnona_area_correction.how: Zakai prepares the correction request and objection to the municipality's arnona manager.

water_leak_credit.title: Concealed water-leak credit
water_leak_credit.desc: An unusually high water bill from a leak you couldn't have known about — a discount on the excess usage, not the whole bill. Requires a plumber's confirmation.
water_leak_credit.how: Zakai prepares the request to the water corporation, including where to attach the repair confirmation.

vaad_bait_accounting_il.title: HOA / building committee transparency
vaad_bait_accounting_il.desc: Request committee reports and explained charges — not legal advice.
vaad_bait_accounting_il.how: Zakai drafts the letter to the committee or management company.

rental_essential_repairs_il.title: Essential repair in a rental
rental_essential_repairs_il.desc: A material defect the landlord must fix — documented demand letter.
rental_essential_repairs_il.how: Zakai prepares the repair demand to your landlord.

consumer_warranty_il.title: Product warranty claim
consumer_warranty_il.desc: Defect in warranty period — repair or replacement under consumer law.
consumer_warranty_il.how: Zakai prepares the warranty letter to the seller or importer.

bank_basic_track.title: Bank basic fee track
bank_basic_track.desc: By law: a low flat-fee track instead of per-action fees. Most people never switch.
bank_basic_track.how: One notice to your bank — it must comply.

bank_senior_track.title: Senior bank-fee discount
bank_senior_track.desc: Seniors and disabled get 50% off the basic track.
bank_senior_track.how: Ask at your branch or in the app.

bank_soldier_student.title: Soldier/student fee exemption
bank_soldier_student.desc: Soldier and student accounts are exempt from most fees.

credit_report_free.title: Free annual credit report
credit_report_free.desc: One free credit-data report a year — check for errors.
credit_report_free.how: Order at the Bank of Israel credit-data system.

dormant_money.title: Dormant money ("Har HaKesef")
dormant_money.desc: Forgotten accounts and deposits — billions await owners.
dormant_money.how: Free search on the Treasury's Har HaKesef site.

hishtalmut_withdrawal.title: Hishtalmut fund withdrawal
hishtalmut_withdrawal.desc: Withdrawable tax-free 6 years after the first deposit — many people don't realize it or forget.
hishtalmut_withdrawal.how: Zakai prepares the withdrawal request to the fund.

mobile_check.title: Mobile bill check
mobile_check.desc: Typical proactive saving: ~18% of the bill. Zakai does it for you.
mobile_check.how: Upload a bill — we act with a power of attorney.

electricity_switch.title: Electricity supplier switch
electricity_switch.desc: Guaranteed 5–7% flat discount, up to 21% with a smart meter.
electricity_switch.how: Compare in Zakai's calculator and switch — no technician.

electricity_social.title: Statutory electricity discount
electricity_social.desc: Certain benefit recipients get a discounted tariff.
electricity_social.how: Verify it's applied on your bill.

subscription_audit.title: Recurring-subscription audit
subscription_audit.how: Run Zakai's statement scan — data never leaves your device.

insurance_duplicates.title: Duplicate insurance check ("Har HaBituach")
insurance_duplicates.desc: Duplicate health/accident coverage is very common.
insurance_duplicates.how: Free check on Har HaBituach; cancel the duplicate.

duplicate_charge_dispute.title: Duplicate or incorrect charge
duplicate_charge_dispute.desc: Charged twice for the same purchase, or the charge doesn't match the receipt — you're entitled to a correction and credit.
duplicate_charge_dispute.how: Zakai prepares the complaint to the provider, including where to attach your receipt or statement as proof.

bank_loan_opening_commission_il.title: Loan opening / handling fee
bank_loan_opening_commission_il.desc: Banks must be transparent — fees not disclosed upfront or charged twice can be challenged.
bank_loan_opening_commission_il.how: Zakai drafts a demand for breakdown and refund; for ongoing bank fees use the agent at /bank-fees.

train_delay_compensation.title: Train delay/cancellation compensation
train_delay_compensation.desc: Israel Railways' own published compensation policy (not a law) — a free ticket for a significant delay.
train_delay_compensation.how: Zakai prepares the request to Israel Railways to claim the compensation.

pension_fees.title: Pension management fees
pension_fees.desc: Half a percent difference is worth hundreds of thousands by retirement.
pension_fees.how: Check your annual report; negotiate or move to a default fund.

discharged_deposit.title: Discharged-soldier deposit
discharged_deposit.desc: Personal money waiting in a deposit; freely usable after 5 years.

reservist_benefits.title: Active reservist benefits
reservist_benefits.desc: Yearly grants, credit points and more.
reservist_benefits.how: Check the Miluim portal — some require application.

daycare_subsidy.title: Daycare subsidy
daycare_subsidy.desc: Significant income-tested subsidy for working parents.
daycare_subsidy.how: Apply via the Labor Ministry at the start of the school year.

child_savings.title: Savings for Every Child
child_savings.desc: The state deposits monthly; you can double it.
child_savings.how: Choose a track and matching deposit at National Insurance.

senior_card.title: Senior citizen card
senior_card.desc: 50% off public transport, medicine and culture discounts.
senior_card.how: Sent automatically; request it if missing.

heating_grant.title: Heating grant
heating_grant.desc: Yearly automatic grant for eligible seniors.
heating_grant.how: Paid with the Oct–Nov pension — verify receipt.

rent_assistance.title: Rent assistance
rent_assistance.desc: Monthly participation in rent for the eligible.

mortgage_refinance.title: Mortgage refinance check
mortgage_refinance.desc: Rate changes can save hundreds monthly.
mortgage_refinance.how: Get a balance report and compare offers — free.

health_dental_kids.title: Free kids' dental care
health_dental_kids.desc: Preventive/restorative dental care for under-18s is in the health basket — many parents pay privately unaware.
health_dental_kids.how: Book at your HMO's dental clinics; token copay only.

health_glasses_kids.title: Kids' glasses reimbursement
health_glasses_kids.desc: Under-18s get funded or reimbursed glasses/lenses via the HMO.
health_glasses_kids.how: Check the HMO arrangement before buying.

health_er_exemption.title: ER fee exemption
health_er_exemption.desc: With a referral, admission, or defined cases (fracture, birth) — no ER fee.
health_er_exemption.how: Arrive with a referral or claim reimbursement with documents.

work_havraa.title: Convalescence pay (havra'a)
work_havraa.desc: After a year of employment you're owed yearly havra'a by seniority.
work_havraa.how: Look for it in summer payslips; missing = claim it.

work_pension_mandatory.title: Mandatory pension
work_pension_mandatory.desc: Every employee is insured by law — ~12.5% employer contributions.
work_pension_mandatory.how: Verify contributions on the payslip and that you chose a fund.

work_travel.title: Commute reimbursement
work_travel.desc: Employers must share commute costs up to the daily cap.
work_travel.how: Compare the payslip line to actual costs.

work_overtime.title: Overtime pay
work_overtime.desc: Hours beyond the full day/week earn 125–150% — 'global' arrangements aren't always legal.
work_overtime.how: Compare attendance to payslip; systematic gaps are claimable 7 years back.

work_sick.title: Sick pay
work_sick.desc: 1.5 sick days accrue monthly; paid partially from day 2, fully from day 4.
work_sick.how: Check your balance — it's money when needed.

transport_youth.title: Youth public-transport discounts
transport_youth.desc: Youth/student/soldier Rav-Kav profiles cut fares by tens of percent.
transport_youth.how: Update your profile at Rav-Kav stations or the app.

route6_dispute.title: Route 6 toll charge dispute
route6_dispute.desc: A wrong or duplicate charge, including a previous owner still being billed after a sale — a statutory appeals committee exists, 30 days from the charge notice.
route6_dispute.how: Zakai prepares the appeal to the committee.

vehicle_license_fee_refund.title: Prorated vehicle license fee refund
vehicle_license_fee_refund.desc: Only when you deregister a vehicle (take it off the road) or it's a total loss — not on an ordinary sale.
vehicle_license_fee_refund.how: Zakai prepares the prorated-refund request to the Ministry of Transport.

student_scholarships.title: Student scholarships
student_scholarships.desc: Hundreds of scholarships by field, need, residence and volunteering — many go unclaimed.
student_scholarships.how: Check your institution, Mifal HaPayis and student-union databases.

consumer_cancel14.title: 14-day remote-purchase cancellation
consumer_cancel14.desc: Online/phone purchases cancel within 14 days for a full refund (limited deduction).
consumer_cancel14.how: Written notice to the business; the law beats 'store policy'.

consumer_telecom_exit.title: Friction-free telecom disconnection
consumer_telecom_exit.desc: Mobile/internet disconnection must be simple, without exit fines beyond the law.
consumer_telecom_exit.how: Demand in writing; stalling is grounds for a ministry complaint.

collection_agency_complaint_il.title: Harassed by a debt collector?
collection_agency_complaint_il.desc: Consumer law and capital-market rules require fair collection — you can demand details and stop harassment.
collection_agency_complaint_il.how: Zakai drafts a complaint and debt-documentation demand before you pay.

car_insurance_pro_rata_refund.title: Cancelled car insurance? Pro-rata refund
car_insurance_pro_rata_refund.desc: Cancelling mid-term entitles you to unused premium back under the Insurance Contracts Law.
car_insurance_pro_rata_refund.how: Zakai drafts cancellation and refund demand to the insurer.

mobility_allowance.title: Mobility allowance
mobility_allowance.desc: Mobility impairment entitles a monthly allowance and car benefits.
mobility_allowance.how: Medical committee via the health bureau + National Insurance claim.

us_eitc.title: Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC)
us_eitc.desc: A refundable credit for low-to-moderate-income workers — worth thousands, yet millions who qualify never claim it.
us_eitc.how: Claim on your federal tax return (IRS Free File); up to 3 years back.

us_ctc.title: Child Tax Credit
us_ctc.desc: Up to $2,000 per qualifying child, partly refundable.
us_ctc.how: Claim on your federal return for each qualifying child.

us_savers_credit.title: Saver's Credit
us_savers_credit.desc: A tax credit just for contributing to a 401(k) or IRA on a modest income.
us_savers_credit.how: File Form 8880 with your tax return.

us_snap.title: SNAP (food assistance)
us_snap.desc: Monthly grocery benefits for low-income households.
us_snap.how: Apply through your state's SNAP agency.

us_medicaid.title: Medicaid
us_medicaid.desc: Free or low-cost health coverage for eligible low-income individuals and families.
us_medicaid.how: Apply via your state Medicaid office or HealthCare.gov.

us_aca_subsidy.title: ACA premium tax credit
us_aca_subsidy.desc: Marketplace subsidies can cut monthly health-insurance premiums sharply — many overpay by not checking.
us_aca_subsidy.how: Compare plans and subsidies at HealthCare.gov during open enrollment.

us_unemployment.title: Unemployment insurance
us_unemployment.desc: Weekly income replacement after losing a job through no fault of your own.
us_unemployment.how: File with your state's unemployment office as soon as you're out of work.

us_ssdi.title: Disability benefits (SSDI / SSI)
us_ssdi.desc: Monthly payments for people unable to work due to a disability.
us_ssdi.how: Apply online with the Social Security Administration (ssa.gov).

us_social_security.title: Social Security retirement
us_social_security.desc: Retirement income based on your work history; timing your claim changes the amount.
us_social_security.how: Check your estimate and apply at ssa.gov.

us_liheap.title: LIHEAP energy assistance
us_liheap.desc: Help paying heating and cooling bills for low-income households.
us_liheap.how: Apply through your state's LIHEAP program.

us_section8.title: Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8)
us_section8.desc: Rental assistance that caps your housing cost at a share of income.
us_section8.how: Apply through your local Public Housing Agency (waitlists apply).

us_pell_grant.title: Pell Grant
us_pell_grant.desc: Federal college aid you don't repay, for undergraduates with financial need.

us_lifeline.title: Lifeline phone/internet discount
us_lifeline.desc: A monthly discount on phone or broadband for eligible low-income households.
us_lifeline.how: Check eligibility and apply at lifelinesupport.org.

us_401k_match.title: 401(k) employer match
us_401k_match.desc: Free money: many employers match retirement contributions — not contributing enough leaves it on the table.
us_401k_match.how: Set your contribution to at least the full match with your HR/plan provider.

us_free_credit_report.title: Free credit reports
us_free_credit_report.desc: By law you can get free reports from all three bureaus — spotting errors can save real money.

us_wage_statement_audit.title: Pay stub / wage statement check
us_wage_statement_audit.desc: Missing overtime, wrong withholdings, or payroll errors? A written request and your own records can surface money owed.
us_wage_statement_audit.how: Use Zakai's wage-statement audit door for a cited letter you send to payroll or HR.

us_fdcpa_debt_validation.title: Debt collector validation (FDCPA)
us_fdcpa_debt_validation.desc: A collector must prove the debt in writing before you pay — you can dispute and pause collection while they respond.
us_fdcpa_debt_validation.how: Use Zakai's debt-collector dispute door for a validation letter with statutory citations.

uk_universal_credit.title: Universal Credit
uk_universal_credit.desc: The main monthly payment for people on a low income or out of work.
uk_universal_credit.how: Apply on GOV.UK; it replaces six older benefits.

uk_child_benefit.title: Child Benefit
uk_child_benefit.desc: A regular payment for anyone responsible for a child — worth claiming even at higher incomes for the NI credit.
uk_child_benefit.how: Claim on GOV.UK; can be backdated 3 months.

uk_marriage_allowance.title: Marriage Allowance
uk_marriage_allowance.desc: A couple can transfer part of a personal tax allowance and cut their tax bill.
uk_marriage_allowance.how: Apply free on GOV.UK; can be backdated 4 years.

uk_council_tax_reduction.title: Council Tax Reduction
uk_council_tax_reduction.desc: Up to a full discount on Council Tax for low-income or eligible households.

uk_jsa.title: Jobseeker's Allowance
uk_jsa.desc: Support while you look for work, based on your National Insurance record.

uk_state_pension.title: State Pension
uk_state_pension.desc: Regular retirement income; you can also check for gaps and top up NI years.
uk_state_pension.how: Check your forecast and claim on GOV.UK.

uk_pip.title: Personal Independence Payment (PIP)
uk_pip.desc: Help with extra costs of a long-term health condition or disability.

uk_winter_fuel.title: Winter Fuel Payment
uk_winter_fuel.desc: A payment to help older people with heating costs in winter.
uk_winter_fuel.how: Most eligible people are paid automatically; check GOV.UK.

uk_warm_home_discount.title: Warm Home Discount
uk_warm_home_discount.desc: A one-off discount off your electricity bill for eligible low-income households.
uk_warm_home_discount.how: Usually applied by your energy supplier; check eligibility on GOV.UK.

uk_housing_benefit.title: Housing support
uk_housing_benefit.desc: Help paying rent for those on a low income (via Universal Credit or Housing Benefit).
uk_housing_benefit.how: Apply on GOV.UK or through your council.

uk_free_childcare.title: Free childcare hours
uk_free_childcare.desc: Funded childcare hours for working parents of young children.
uk_free_childcare.how: Apply through Childcare Choices on GOV.UK.

uk_student_finance.title: Student finance & grants
uk_student_finance.desc: Tuition and maintenance loans, plus grants for eligible students.
uk_student_finance.how: Apply through Student Finance on GOV.UK.

terms.p: Zakai is a consumer self-help digital service: it checks bills and entitlements, builds comparisons and generates outreach letters — and for consumer matters (such as a mobile or electricity bill) it may relay a request to the provider as the user's messenger, with explicit per-request authorization. Zakai is not a lawyer, tax adviser, pension adviser, insurance agent or investment adviser; provides no legal or professional advice of any kind; does not represent the user in any legal or quasi-judicial proceeding; and does not perform acts reserved by law to lawyers. Demand letters and legal checks are self-help templates — the user reviews, adopts and sends them, in their own name and on their own responsibility.

All estimates and recommendations are orientation only. Zakai does not guarantee savings, compensation or any outcome; actual results depend on factors beyond our control. Calculations are based on the data the user enters — wrong, partial or outdated input may produce a wrong result, and responsibility for the accuracy of the data rests solely with the user. Results are not a substitute for checking with the competent body (the provider, the authority, an accountant or a lawyer) or for professional advice.

A success fee is charged only on savings documented in the system, at the rate of the user's plan at documentation time. Users have 14 days to dispute a charge; if the saving did not materialize, the fee is cancelled or refunded.

A subscription (Pro/Max) is a continuing transaction, cancellable at any time from the settings screen with no penalty; cancellation takes effect from the next cycle and does not affect what was already provided. The first message to a provider is sent only after your explicit tap in the app. While the Mandate stays active and not revoked, Zakai may send written follow-ups on the same matter if no reply arrives within several days (per the system schedule), up to four rounds total per case. Each message carries the verifiable authorization document; revoking the Mandate stops new sends immediately.

baggage.sub: Almost every international flight is covered by the Montreal Convention, which entitles you to compensation for expenses caused by baggage delay or loss. Airlines offer a small voucher — but you're owed much more.
baggage.capNote: (1,519 SDR) per passenger — for essential expenses caused by the delay or loss. It's a cap, not a fixed sum; you claim actual expenses.
rights: Reimbursement for essential purchases (clothes, toiletries) you had to make while your bag was delayed — up to the cap.
Total loss of a bag (usually after 21 days) entitles you to compensation for the full contents, up to the cap.
A refund of baggage fees you paid if the service wasn't properly provided.
The right stands on its own — even if the airline offered you a voucher or small 'goodwill' payment.
steps: At the airport immediately: file a Property Irregularity Report (PIR) at the airline desk. Without that number claiming is hard.
Keep every receipt for essential purchases made because of the delay — photograph them.
Submit a written compensation claim to the airline with the PIR and receipts, within the Convention's window (21 days for delay).
Don't sign a 'full and final' settlement for a low sum before checking what you're owed on actual expenses.
traps: They present an internal '~$50/day guideline' as if it's the legal cap — it isn't. The cap is far higher.
They treat a reimbursement as an 'advance' and deduct it from the final payout — insist it's separate.
They demand original receipts only and reject photos — keep both the original and a digital copy.

cta.body: Beyond baggage, a delay or cancellation of the flight itself can entitle you to hundreds of euros more under EC261 and Israel's Aviation Services Law.

arnona.metaDesc: Roughly 1 in 3 properties is over-charged arnona — wrong measurement, wrong classification, or a missed discount. Here's how to check and file an objection, with a ready letter.
arnona.title: You may be over-paying arnona — and you can get it back
arnona.sub: Arnona (municipal property tax) is one of a household's largest fixed costs, and measurement and classification errors are very common. One correction is worth hundreds to thousands of shekels a year — every year. Here's exactly what to check and how to file an objection.
arnona.errorsTitle: Where it usually goes against you

errors.name: Over-measured area
errors.note: The city charges for a larger area than the real one — the most common and most worthwhile error to check.

errors.name: Wrong classification
errors.note: Residential charged as business, or a service area (storage/balcony) charged as primary area at a higher rate.

errors.name: Missed discount
errors.note: Senior, single parent, disability or low income — discounts you're owed that weren't applied automatically.

errors.name: Wrong billing zone
errors.note: Each zone in the city has a different rate; a wrong assignment inflates the charge for nothing.

arnona.stepsTitle: How to file an objection — step by step
steps: Ask the municipality for the property's measurement and classification data (freedom-of-information request or via the authority's site).
Compare the area to the plan/actual measurement, and check whether a discount you're owed wasn't applied.
File a written objection with the Arnona Manager — usually within 90 days of the annual charge notice.
Denied? You have the right to appeal to the arnona objections committee, and then to the administrative court.
arnona.templateSub: Fill in your details, tick the relevant reasons, and send it yourself to the municipality's Arnona Manager.

To
The Arnona Manager, ____ Municipality

Re: Objection to arnona (municipal property tax) charge — property at ____, payer no. ____

My name is ____, the occupier of the property above. Under the Local Authorities (Objection to General Arnona) Law, 1976, I hereby object to the arnona charge, on the following grounds:

[ ] The charged area is incorrect / over-measured versus the actual area.
[ ] The property classification is wrong (e.g. residential charged as business).
[ ] Discounts/exemptions I am entitled to were not applied (senior / single parent / disability / low income).
[ ] The billing zone does not match the property's location.

Please provide the measurement and classification data the charge is based on, correct the charge accordingly, and credit me retroactively for any overcharge.

I would appreciate a reasoned written reply within the statutory period. Should the objection be denied, I reserve my right to appeal to the arnona objections committee.

Respectfully,
____

dupInsurance.metaDesc: Israelis pay ~3.5B ILS a year on duplicate insurance. With indemnity policies you pay twice but can claim once. Here's how to spot duplicates and get a refund, with a ready letter.
dupInsurance.title: You may be paying for duplicate insurance — and can only claim once
dupInsurance.sub: Israelis pay around 3.5 billion shekels a year on duplicate policies covering exactly the same risk. In many cases you can't even claim twice — so you pay double and receive once. Here's how to spot it and get a refund.
dupInsurance.keyTitle: The distinction that saves you money: indemnity vs compensation
dupInsurance.keyBody: With indemnity policies (surgery, health, medication) the law forbids receiving more than the actual cost — so two duplicate policies mean double payment, single payout. Compensation policies (critical illness, life) can pay from several companies. The wasted duplication concentrates in indemnity policies.

areas.name: Surgery cover
areas.note: Commonly duplicated against the HMO's supplementary insurance — you pay for the same cover twice.

areas.name: Medication outside the basket
areas.note: Mostly covered by supplementary HMO cover; a parallel private policy is often redundant.

areas.name: Long-term care
areas.note: A group HMO policy alongside private long-term-care cover — check there is no overlap.

areas.name: Personal accident
areas.note: Duplication between workplace cover and a separately bought private policy.

dupInsurance.stepsTitle: How to check and get a refund
steps: Log in to 'Har HaBituach' (harb.cma.gov.il) and pull the list of all active policies in your name.
Flag indemnity policies covering the same risk in more than one place — that's where the duplication is.
Ask the insurer to cancel the redundant cover and refund duplicated premiums (ready letter below).
Denied? Approach the company's public-enquiries officer, then the Capital Market, Insurance and Savings Authority.
dupInsurance.templateSub: Fill in your details and send it to the insurer. You can send it to each company where you hold overlapping cover.
dupInsurance.template:
To
Customer Service / Public Enquiries, ____ (insurer)

Re: Request to check duplicate insurance and refund premiums — policy no. ____

My name is ____, the insured under the policy above. I suspect I hold duplicate indemnity-type cover (e.g. surgery / health / medication / long-term care) covering the same risk in another policy with you and/or another company.

With indemnity-type policies, one cannot receive more than the actual loss, so paying duplicate premiums does not buy me additional cover. Under the Insurance Contract Law and the Capital Market Authority's rules on selling duplicate policies, I request:

1. A full list of all active cover in my name with you and its type (indemnity / compensation).
2. A review of whether duplicate cover exists, and cancellation of the redundant cover.
3. A refund of premiums charged in duplicate, where duplicate cover was sold improperly and without informed consent.

I would appreciate a reasoned written reply. I reserve my right to approach your public-enquiries officer and the Capital Market Authority.

Respectfully,
____
Date: ____

deposit.title: Landlord not returning your deposit? You're owed it back
deposit.sub: A rental deposit secures your obligations — it's not the landlord's property. Only a proven debt may be deducted (unpaid rent, an open bill, real damage) — never reasonable wear or 'just because'. Here's how to get it back.
deposit.rulesTitle: What the landlord may deduct — and may not

rules.name: Reasonable wear — not deductible
rules.note: Ordinary use (faded paint, picture holes) is natural wear and can't be deducted from the deposit.

rules.name: Proven damage — only with evidence
rules.note: Real damage beyond wear can be deducted, but only against proof and a repair invoice.

rules.name: Open debts only
rules.note: Unpaid rent or bills (electricity/water/arnona) left open in your name — a legitimate deduction.

rules.name: Holding it 'as security' — unlawful
rules.note: The landlord can't keep the deposit as pressure or 'just in case' without a proven debt.

deposit.stepsTitle: How to demand your deposit back
steps: Document the apartment's condition on move-out (photos + meters) — your proof you left no damage.
By law the landlord must return the deposit within 60 days of vacating — send a written demand once that deadline has passed (ready letter below).
Demand a breakdown and evidence for any deduction — a deduction without proof isn't legitimate.
Not returned? You can file a small-claims case (up to the statutory cap) yourself, no lawyer needed.

alimonyGuarantee.title: The other parent isn't paying child support? National Insurance can pay it instead
alimonyGuarantee.sub: When a court has ruled on alimony and the liable parent isn't paying, the Alimony (Payment Guarantee) Law, 5732-1972 lets National Insurance pay you instead — then collect the money from the liable parent itself, including through enforcement proceedings. The initial check is free.
alimonyGuarantee.bigNumber: A monthly payment instead of the parent who isn't paying
alimonyGuarantee.bigNumberSub: The exact amount depends on your court judgment and the regulations (whichever is lower), plus an income test — National Insurance publishes an official calculator for your amount. This is a statutory right, not a favor.

kinds.title: There's a court judgment
kinds.body: A court or religious court set an alimony amount — and the liable parent isn't paying it as ordered.

kinds.title: Income test
kinds.body: Eligibility depends on your income from work and other sources — checked against the alimony regulations.

kinds.title: Israeli residency
kinds.body: The basic condition is Israeli residency — National Insurance checks this against your application details.

kinds.title: Mainly child support
kinds.body: The mechanism is mainly built for guaranteeing child support; eligibility details for spousal alimony vary by case.

steps: Gather two certified copies of the court judgment setting the alimony (and any relevant divorce agreement).
Fill out form Bl/5400 ("Application for Payment under the Alimony Law") at your nearest National Insurance branch.
Attach recent payslips and proof of any other income — you can add documents later so the application date isn't delayed.
Once approved, National Insurance pays you and pursues collecting the full amount from the liable parent itself.

businessCompensation.kicker: Compensation for businesses hit by the war
businessCompensation.title: Was your business hurt by the war? The Tax Authority pays compensation for indirect damage
businessCompensation.sub: Under the Property Tax and Compensation Fund Law, 1961 and the emergency regulations issued for each operation, businesses and self-employed people whose income dropped because of the war are entitled to compensation from the Tax Authority — based on the drop in turnover compared to a parallel period. Over ₪15 billion has already been paid out under the program, and many eligible businesses either never filed or got a lower offer than they were owed.
businessCompensation.bigNumber: Over ₪15 billion paid so far across 525,000 claims
businessCompensation.bigNumberSub: State Comptroller data on the program overall. What a specific business is owed depends entirely on its own drop in turnover and the relevant track — there's no single "typical" number, and every case is assessed on its own.

kinds.title: Turnover track
kinds.body: Compares the turnover of the claimed month against the same calendar month before the war — compensation based on the percentage drop.

kinds.title: Expenses track
kinds.body: Compensation based on the business's fixed expenses, for businesses the turnover track doesn't fit.

kinds.title: Red track / special zone
kinds.body: More favorable terms for businesses in border communities, the Gaza envelope, and the northern zone.

kinds.title: Nationwide expenses track
kinds.body: Open to eligible sectors across the whole country, not just war zones — subject to the terms of the active track.

businessCompensation.howTitle: How to file, and what to do if the offer is too low
steps: Check the Tax Authority site (gov.il) for which tracks are currently open and the filing window — this changes between operations.
Prepare the turnover/expenses data for the comparison period, matching the track that fits your business.
File the claim online; an advance of 60% of the claimed amount is typically paid within 21 days.
Got too low an offer? You have the right to file an objection within 60 days, and appeal to the appeals committee within another 30 days if the objection is denied.

holocaustSurvivors.title: A Holocaust survivor in the family? Several bodies can pay — easy to miss one
holocaustSurvivors.sub: Several separate bodies in Israel pay Holocaust survivors — the Authority for the Rights of Holocaust Survivors, the Claims Conference, and in some cases funds abroad. Each has its own criteria, and each can change. That's why a right gets missed — not because none is owed. This page never charges a fee for anything, ever.
holocaustSurvivors.bigNumberSub: The Authority for the Rights of Holocaust Survivors, the Claims Conference (Article 2 / CEEF, the Hardship Fund), and funds in Germany and Austria — each with a different process and terms. Exact amounts change and get updated, so none are listed here — the official hotline below has the current numbers.

kinds.title: Authority for the Rights of Holocaust Survivors
kinds.body: A monthly stipend and annual grant for anyone recognized as a victim of Nazi persecution, based on immigration date and type of persecution. Related benefits: medication, arnona discounts, TV-license exemption, and more.

kinds.title: Claims Conference
kinds.body: The Article 2/CEEF program — a fixed quarterly payment. The Hardship Fund — a one-time payment for anyone who never received other compensation. Both still open to new applicants.

kinds.title: Austrian National Fund
kinds.body: For survivors persecuted as Austrian Jews — a one-time payment plus ongoing annual support for those in financial hardship. Still open to new applications.

kinds.title: Kol Zchut (Voice of Rights)
kinds.body: The Authority's official national hotline — the first place to check which rights actually apply, instead of guessing.

steps: Call the Authority's "Kol Zchut" hotline — *5105 or 03-5682651 — and check what's already recognized and what isn't.
If the Israeli Authority hasn't covered everything, check with the Claims Conference for a program that fits.
For survivors persecuted as Austrian Jews, also check with the Austrian National Fund.
NGOs like Amuta Aviv (עמותת אביב) help survivors exhaust their rights for free — worth reaching out to them in parallel.

cta.title: Want help finding your way?

carValue.metaDesc: Were you in an accident? You're owed compensation for the car's diminished value — usually thousands of shekels. Insurers don't offer it. Here's how to claim.
carValue.title: Were you in an accident? You're owed diminished-value compensation nobody told you about
carValue.sub: Even after the car is repaired like new, its market value drops simply because it was in an accident — that's 'diminished value', and you're owed compensation for it. Insurers know this and don't offer it. Most drivers give up without knowing. The initial check is free.
carValue.bigNumber: Usually thousands ₪ — sometimes tens of thousands
carValue.bigNumberSub: Diminished value is calculated as a percentage of the car's value by severity and the parts damaged. On a newer/expensive car or a significant accident it can reach tens of thousands of shekels — money owed to you under the policy or from the at-fault party.

facts.title: It happens even after a perfect repair
facts.body: The mere accident record lowers the car's resale price. The compensation is for that gap — not the repair.

facts.title: The insurer won't offer it
facts.body: Insurers pay for the repair but 'forget' to mention diminished value. You have to demand it explicitly.

facts.title: Owed from the at-fault party too
facts.body: If a third party caused the accident, you're owed full diminished-value compensation from them/their insurer, on top of the repair.

facts.title: There's a time window
facts.body: A diminished-value claim has a limitation period. Best to act close to the event, while documentation is fresh.

carValue.howTitle: How to claim it — the right way
steps: Keep all documents: appraiser's report, repair invoice, garage confirmation and accident details.
Order an appraiser's diminished-value opinion — it quantifies how much the car's value dropped. That's the document that speaks.
Send a reasoned demand to the insurer (yours or the at-fault party's) with the appraisal.
Didn't pay what's owed? That's exactly a success-fee claim — no upfront pay.

vehiclePurchaseBlocked.body: Input VAT on buying, importing or leasing a private passenger car is not deductible, except for specific trades such as driving schools, car rental and passenger transport.

hospitalityBlocked.body: Input VAT on hospitality and entertainment is not deductible at all, even where income tax allows part of the expense.

partialDeduction.body: Mixed-use inputs are deducted at a reduced rate: two thirds where the use is mainly business, a quarter where it is mainly private.

refundPosition.title: The return comes out as a refund
refundPosition.body: A refund position is entirely legitimate — an equipment-heavy period, or an exporter — but it is also the most scrutinised filing there is. Make sure every invoice is on file.

belowPaturCeiling.body: Annual turnover is still under the exempt-dealer ceiling. This is the headroom remaining — worth checking with your accountant which status pays off.
